title: Deuteronomy Bible Quiz - Chapter 31
description: Ten questions on Deuteronomy 31: Moses at one hundred twenty, Joshua commissioned, and the song as a witness.

questions.text: How old does Moses say he is today?
questions.explanation: Moses says, "I am one hundred twenty years old today."

questions.text: What has Yahweh told Moses he shall not do?
questions.explanation: Moses says Yahweh told him, "You shall not go over this Jordan."

questions.text: Which kings does Moses mention as an example of what Yahweh will do to the nations?
questions.explanation: Yahweh will do to the nations as he did to Sihon and to Og, the kings of the Amorites, when he destroyed them.

answers.text: Sihon and Og, the kings of the Amorites
The kings of Edom and Moab

questions.text: What did Moses say to Joshua in the sight of all Israel?
questions.explanation: Moses called Joshua and said to him in the sight of all Israel, "Be strong and courageous," for he would go with the people into the land.

questions.text: To whom did Moses deliver the law he had written?
questions.explanation: Moses wrote this law and delivered it to the priests the sons of Levi, who bore the ark, and to all the elders of Israel.

answers.text: Joshua the son of Nun and the captains of the army
The priests the sons of Levi and all the elders of Israel
The heads of the tribe of Judah and their officers
The singers and the gatekeepers of the Tent

questions.text: When was this law to be read before all Israel?
questions.explanation: Moses commanded that at the end of every seven years, in the feast of booths, the law was to be read before all Israel.

answers.text: At the end of every seven years, in the feast of booths
Every Sabbath day at the gate of the city
At every new moon, in the Tent of Meeting
Once a year, on the day of the Passover

questions.text: In what did Yahweh appear at the Tent of Meeting?
questions.explanation: Verse 15 says Yahweh appeared in the Tent in a pillar of cloud, which stood over the Tent's door.

questions.text: Why did Yahweh tell Moses to write this song and teach it to Israel?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said to put the song in their mouths, "that this song may be a witness for me against the children of Israel."

answers.text: So that they would sing it at the feast of booths
So that they would remember the way out of Egypt
So that it would be a witness for Yahweh against the children of Israel
So that the nations would fear them

questions.text: Where were the Levites to put the book of the law?
questions.explanation: Moses told the Levites to put the book of the law by the side of the ark of the covenant, as a witness against the people.

answers.text: By the side of the ark of the covenant
Inside the ark of the covenant
Under the altar of burnt offering

questions.text: What does Moses say he knows about the people?
questions.explanation: Moses says, "For I know your rebellion and your stiff neck."

answers.text: Their rebellion and their stiff neck
